items.q: Like I used to study Rimsky-Korsakoff's book on orchestrating

ctx.x: Like I used to study Rimsky-Korsakoff's book on orchestrating, and I think he was one of the greatest in keeping it transparent, where you can understand it all, you know? And to learn, don't be afraid of simplicity, you know?
